title: Minecraft 1.8.8
description: Minecraft 1.8.8 is a minor update to Java Edition released on July 28, 2015. This version focuses mainly on security improvements, crash fixes, and general stability. It introduces the Splatter minigame to Realms, adds realm-wide resource packs for custom maps and minigames, and improves resource pack compatibility warnings. It also fixes 38 bugs, making the game more stable while maintaining the classic 1.8 experience.
